description.text:
Offering an all-day Grab and Go menu, featuring their bold and bright signature field trays from breakfast through to dinner.

Open from 7am, Redemption Roaster speciality coffees will kick things off for early risers and breakfast field trays will include poached eggs, flank steak and roasted vegetables; vegan shakshuka with grilled aubergine, mushroom, wilted spinach and tahini, or a choice or grab and go options and their new porridge offering.

For lunch and dinner, guests can take their pick of Farmer J favourites to create their own field tray, with bases including Farmer’s field grains, brown rice or spinach, mains including grilled chermoula chicken, Malaysian meatballs and their new, miso tofu cannelloni with sides such as mac’n’cheese, whole rooasted cauliflower, roasted sweet potato or purple garden salad.

data.street_address: Canada Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 5AH
